$Comment: A bag of Christmas treats: one draw from the bag below, weighted against each other, mostly candy canes
or cookies, now and then a Hot Cocoa, once in a while a Christmas Cake. Christmas Morning's present pays
it on a server without MMO Skill Tree, in place of the boost token that server has nowhere to put
(Quests/SeasonsOfOrbis/_Christmas/Morning.json, the row gated with Max 0), so the present feels as full
on both. Every item goes where the player's pickup settings send it, and whatever their bag cannot take
drops at their feet. Text names this table wherever a reward paying it is shown; its hover lists what
it pays. Its words are in christmas.mmo.lang.
Name: Christmas_Treats
